## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Use `Closes #N` for completed work or `Refs #N` for partial work.

## Implementation and compatibility

Explain the important architecture decision, legacy-data handling, and any migration or failure behavior.

## Verification

List the commands and outcomes. Identify the tested app, harness or device and link the relevant EVIDENCE.md entry.

- [ ] The issue's acceptance criteria are satisfied or remaining items are listed.
- [ ] Relevant platform checks and clean-source verification pass.
- [ ] Shared changes are synced to the current targets, when applicable.
- [ ] Evidence identifies verified results and open device checks.
